component.name: waydlp
component.summary: Download video and audio in the format you want

description.p: waydlp is a fast, private media downloader powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Paste a link, pick a format and quality, and download — from any website supported by yt-dlp.

ul.li: Video as MP4, MKV, WebM or MOV, with real quality choices from 144p to 8K
Audio as MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC, WAV or OGG with optional loudness normalisation
Playlists with item selection, batch downloads and a download queue
Subtitles, thumbnails, chapters and metadata embedding
No accounts, no ads and no tracking

description.p: Only download media you have the right to access. waydlp does not circumvent DRM.
Optional automatic yt-dlp updates, a warning when yt-dlp is outdated, "Retry failed" in the queue, and many fixes.
